short: A Queen Elizabeth-class battleship that became one of the most distinguished and highly decorated ships in the history of the Royal Navy.
full:
Commissioned on 8 March 1915, HMS Warspite was a super-dreadnought of the Queen Elizabeth class, notable for mounting 15-inch guns and running entirely on oil fuel. She sustained heavy damage at the Battle of Jutland in 1916, where a steering failure caused her to circle helplessly under the combined fire of the German High Seas Fleet, yet she survived and continued to fight.

Extensively modernised during the interwar period, she went on to serve with distinction across multiple theatres in the Second World War. She fought at Narvik, Cape Matapan, and the Normandy landings, earning the nickname 'The Grand Old Lady'. She suffered damage from a Fritz X guided bomb off Salerno but remained operational until 1945, cementing her reputation before being decommissioned.
